screenpixvoices.us.description: An ex-commando (Jim Brown) avenges his slain parents, followed by a hunt for a mob boss (Rip Torn) in Mexico. - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Crack House
screenpixvoices.us.description: A gang member goes undercover for the police to nail a drug lord (Jim Brown) who has corrupted his girlfriend. - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: Original Gangstas
screenpixvoices.us.description: Former gang members return to depressed Gary, Ind., to quell violence perpetrated by their successors. - 1996

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Mercenary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (Western) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Escort West
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection. (Western) - 1959

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Canyon Crossroads
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Henchmen in a helicopter chase a Utah prospector (Richard Basehart) seeking uranium with a professor and his daughter (Phyllis Kirk). (Western) - 1955

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wild Horse Stampede
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) stop horse rustlers for Indians and a railroad. (Western) - 1943

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - End of the Line

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Comeback Trail
shoxbetwest.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. (Comedy) - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Heart Specialist
shoxbetwest.us.description: After following a former girlfriend to Florida, Ray Howard (Brian J. White) winds up as an intern in a not-so-prestigious teaching hospital. An unapologetic Lothario, Ray tries to work his charms on nurse Donna (Zoe Saldana), but she's already involved with the chief resident, Dr. Sidney Zachary (Wood Harris), who is also Ray's instructor. Sidney, who moonlights as a standup comic, decides that Ray needs to learn about true love, as well as medicine. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
shoxbetwest.us.description: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison decides to get away. After adopting a new identity, she meets Alex Stone and learns to love again. All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kokomo City
shoxbetwest.us.description: Four Black transgender sex workers tell their life stories in intimate and candid interviews. (Documentary) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: Seaside
shoxbetwest.us.description: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Bang Bang
shoxbetwest.us.description: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past. (Drama) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Undisputed
shoxbetwest.us.description: An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion. (Drama, Action) - 2002

shoxbetwest.us.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
shoxbetwest.us.description: In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose. (Comedy, Romance, Fantasy, Horror) - 1995

shoxbetwest.us.title: Regarding Us
shoxbetwest.us.description: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. (Drama, Comedy) - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: Love & Basketball
shoxbetwest.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (Romance, Drama) - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Bodyguard
shoxbetwest.us.description: Best-selling pop diva Rachel Marron has a stalker whose obsession has risen to the level of disturbing threats. At the urging of her manager, Rachel hires former Secret Service agent Frank Farmer as her bodyguard. Initially resented and treated with disdain for his hard-nosed security procedures, Farmer soon becomes an integral part of Rachel's inner circle. As they spend more time together, client and protector become closer still. (Drama, Romance) - 1992

shoxbetwest.us.title: Persona
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. (Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
shoxbetwest.us.description: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Dark Tower

shoxbetwest.us.description: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. (Comedy, Horror) - 2013

shoxbetwest.us.title: A Haunted House 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. (Comedy, Horror) - 2014

shoxbetwest.us.title: Fist Fight
shoxbetwest.us.description: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.description: A raw and intimate documentary look at the wildly colorful life of legendary funk artist Rick James; original interviews with artists, collaborators and friends. (Special, Documentary) - 2021-09-03

shoxbetwest.us.title: Hard Truths
shoxbetwest.us.description: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. (Comedy drama) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Dutchman
shoxbetwest.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.description: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Violent Heart
shoxbetwest.us.description: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart. (Thriller, Drama) - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: Pulp Fiction
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days. - 1994

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sound of Violence
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

showtimeshowcase.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1996

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sweet Virginia
showtimeshowcase.us.description: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Tale of the Mummy
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help. (Horror) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Red Eye
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Just Go With It
showtimeshowcase.us.description: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. (Romantic comedy, Comedy) - 2011

showtimeshowcase.us.title: When Harry Met Sally...
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them. (Romantic comedy) - 1989

showtimeshowcase.us.title: She's Out of My League
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: A Simple Plan
showtimeshowcase.us.description: While in the woods near their small town, upstanding local Hank Mitchell (Bill Paxton), his dim brother Jacob (Billy Bob Thornton) and their friend Lou (Brent Briscoe) discover a crashed plane with two things in it -- a dead pilot, and a stash of more than four million dollars. Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Marathon Man
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War) - 1976

showtimeshowcase.us.title: We Were Soldiers
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. (Drama) - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction. (War, Drama) - 1979

showtimeshowcase.us.title: V for Vengeance
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After learning that their younger sibling escaped an earlier kidnapping attempt that also killed their parents, two estranged sisters must join forces to rescue her from a group of bloodthirsty vampires. Out for revenge and control of a vampirism vaccine, Thorn and his band of the undead soon learn that they messed with the wrong family. (Horror, Action) - 2022

showtimeshowcase.us.title: We Were Soldiers

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Changing Lanes
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2016

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shutter Island
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Gangs of New York
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (Historical drama, Crime drama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Stepford Wives
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2004

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Best in Show
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. (Comedy, LGBTQ) - 2000

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Old Guy
showtimeshowcase.us.description: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Old School
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity. - 2003

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers. - 2011

showtimeextreme.us.title: The November Man
showtimeextreme.us.description: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protégé (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score. (Action, Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Adventure) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Basic Instinct
showtimeextreme.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

showtimeextreme.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
showtimeextreme.us.description: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 2001

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Devil Inside
showtimeextreme.us.description: Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Shutter Island

showtimeextreme.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimeextreme.us.description: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. (Thriller, Horror) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Cured
showtimeextreme.us.description: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. (Horror, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimeextreme.us.description: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Wild Wild West
showtimeextreme.us.description: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction) - 1999

showtimeextreme.us.title: Get Hard
showtimeextreme.us.description: When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other. (Comedy) - 2015

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Equalizer 2
showtimeextreme.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. (Action, Thriller) - 2018

showtimeextreme.us.title: Blade Runner 2049
showtimeextreme.us.description: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Yards
showtimeextreme.us.description: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. (Crime drama) - 2000

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
showtimeextreme.us.description: Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions. (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 1996

showtimeextreme.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeextreme.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Saint
showtimeextreme.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. (Action) - 1997

showtimeextreme.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
showtimeextreme.us.description: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer. (Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2007

showtimeextreme.us.title: Hostage
showtimeextreme.us.description: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family. (Action, Thriller) - 2005

showtimeextreme.us.title: Argo
showtimeextreme.us.description: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeextreme.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. (Drama) - 2025

showtimeextreme.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtimeextreme.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. - 2024

showtimeextreme.us.title: Troy
showtimeextreme.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy. - 2004

showtimeextreme.us.title: Colossal
showtimeextreme.us.description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world. - 2016

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to China, a twelve-year-old boy falls in love with one of his classmates. This soon comes to the attention of the class bully.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Babe
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Liar Liar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Gabby's dollhouse, her most prized possession, ends up in the hands of an eccentric cat lady named Vera, she sets off on an adventure through the real world to get the Gabby Cats back together before it's too late.

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Back-up Plan
starzencorefamily.us.description: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

starzencorefamily.us.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
starzencorefamily.us.description: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. (Romance, Comedy, Adventure) - 2004

starzencorefamily.us.title: A Dog and Pony Show
starzencorefamily.us.description: Dede, a famous performing circus dog, gets left behind when her show leaves town. When she is adopted by a lonely boy on a farm, the vain dog has to learn to get along with the other animals. (Children, Comedy) - 2018

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Ladybug
starzencorefamily.us.description: A seven-spotted ladybug dreams of escaping its glass cage and finding the Golden Canyon, a legendary insect utopia. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 2018

starzencore.us.title: Couples Retreat
starzencore.us.description: Four couples, all friends, descend on a tropical island resort. Though one husband and wife are there to work on their marriage, the others just want to enjoy some fun in the sun. They soon find out that the paradise comes at a price, participation in couples therapy sessions is mandatory. What started out as a cut-rate vacation turns into an examination of the common problems many face. (Comedy) - 2009

starzencore.us.title: Priest
starzencore.us.description: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills. (Fantasy, Horror, Action) - 2011

starzencore.us.title: Deliver Us From Evil
starzencore.us.description: As a veteran member of a South Bronx precinct, NYPD Sgt. Ralph Sarchie (Eric Bana) has seen more than his share of dark and horrifying events -- so many that they have begun to poison his soul. Sarchie further finds his beliefs and understanding pushed to the limit when he and his partner investigate a particularly bizarre incident. He forms an alliance with a renegade priest (Edgar Ramírez), who tries to convince Sarchie that real evil -- and demons -- do exist. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

starzencore.us.title: Catching Dust
starzencore.us.description: Geena finally decides to leave her criminal husband Clyde and their isolated Texas hideout, but a couple from New York suddenly arrives. Ignoring the risks, she convinces Clyde to let them stay, a decision with dangerous consequences. (Drama) - 2024

starzencore.us.title: Eye for an Eye
starzencore.us.description: Grieving the sudden death of her parents, Anna relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she's never met. Isolated and in unfamiliar surroundings, she falls in with a couple of local teens, but when she becomes a bystander to an unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman, the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies' dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake. (Horror) - 2025

starzencore.us.title: Beast
starzencore.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. (Action, Drama) - 2026

starzencore.us.title: Clueless
starzencore.us.description: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him. (Comedy, Romance) - 1995

starzencore.us.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
starzencore.us.description: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You." (Holiday, Special, Entertainment, Music) - 2022-12-20

Once there, the baby-faced thief endures the other man's attempts at fatherhood while waiting for a chance to take back the stolen gem he hid in the wife's purse. (Comedy) - 2006

starzencore.us.description: After hitting a wall in his case against drug kingpin Ernesto Mendoza (Andrew Divoff), private eye Andre Shame (Keenen Ivory Wayans) quits the police department in disgrace. The wisecracking investigator thinks he's left his old life behind him, but now everything changes when an old chum from the force informs him of a break in the case. With the help of his motor-mouthed secretary, Peaches (Jada Pinkett), Andre leaps back into the action to solve the case and clear his name. (Action, Comedy) - 1994

starzencore.us.title: The Sixth Man
starzencore.us.description: Brothers Kenny (Marlon Wayans) and Antoine Tyler (Kadeem Hardison) have always wanted to be basketball heroes, standing out as child athletes and now as college players at the University of Washington. But tragedy strikes during a game, when Kenny, the superstar of the family, sustains a fatal heart attack while playing. This forces Antoine to become the leader on the court, but not without some help from his brother, who returns as a ghost to help the Washington team in its quest for glory. (Comedy) - 1997

starzencore.us.title: Let's Be Cops
starzencore.us.description: Best pals Ryan (Jake Johnson) and Justin (Damon Wayans Jr.) are stalled in their respective careers -- a fact that is painfully driven home when they go to a college reunion. Dressed as police in the mistaken belief that they were to attend a costume party, Ryan and Justin find that the uniforms earn them much respect and attention. Although Justin is uncomfortable with the idea, Ryan decides to continue with the charade, putting them both in increasingly dangerous situations. (Comedy, Action) - 2014

Soon, however, E.T. falls ill, resulting in government intervention and a dire situation for both Elliott and the alien. (Family, Science fiction, Adventure) - 1982

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Cariboo Trail
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Though most men are concerned with prospecting gold, American ranchers Jim Redfern and Mike Evans are trying to make a fortune by leading a long line of cattle from Montana to Canada. While they are resting one night, their herd is robbed by a gang of thugs, leaving the cowboys stranded in the wilderness without their livelihood. Jim and Mike then decide to try their hands at mining gold, but before long they run into the enemy bandits again. (Western) - 1950

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Little Big Horn
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Dead Birds
starzencorewesterns.us.description: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted. (Horror) - 2004

starzencorewesterns.us.title: The Proud Rebel
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Tornado Range
starzencorewesterns.us.description: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King. (Western) - 1948

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Overland Riders
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers. (Western) - 1946

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Blue Steel
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy. (Western) - 1934

starzencorewesterns.us.title: Randy Rides Alone
starzencorewesterns.us.description: Undercover government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) rides into a small town, happening upon a saloon that's just been shot up. Wary of the newcomer, the sheriff (Earle Dwire) arrests Randy for the murders, but the saloon owner's niece, Sally Rogers (Alberta Vaughn), helps him escape because she knows he didn't do it. Randy then sets out to find the man behind the murders and is led to an evil mastermind named Marvin Black (George Hayes), who has been passing himself off as an innocent mute. (Western, Action, Drama) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Torture Garden
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sideshow psychic Dr. Diabolo (Burgess Meredith) predicts the horrific futures of some curious fairground visitors. Wealthy Colin (Michael Bryant) finds himself compelled to murder. Ruthless actress Carla (Beverly Adams) discovers that movie stars have a shocking secret. Lovestruck reporter Dorothy (Barbara Ewing) does battle with the spirit of her beloved's dead mother. And greedy Edgar Allan Poe collector Ronald (Jack Palance) finds out a horrifying truth about his idol after murdering a rival. (Horror) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: From Beyond the Grave
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The sinister owner (Peter Cushing) of a London antiques shop leads customers into four tales of terror. (Horror, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Kwaidan
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden (Keiko Kishi), but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi (Katsuo Nakamura) is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author (Osamu Takizawa) relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup. (Horror, Fantasy) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Cases of Murder
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The first in this triptych of strange tales centers on a museum worker (Hugh Pryse), who discovers he can wander into the paintings he guards. Next, George (Emrys Jones) becomes rivals with a friend when they fall for the same girl (Elizabeth Sellars), but things turn dark when she turns up dead. Finally, after the powerful Lord Mountdrago (Orson Welles) ruins a politician's career during a heated debate, the ruined man (Alan Badel) seeks revenge by attacking Mountdrago in his dreams. (Horror) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Painted Desert
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Hugh buys the deed to the Banning mine, and sells it to Bob when he thinks it is worthless. When he learns the mine is full of tungsten, he sets out to get it back. (Western) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Powdersmoke Range
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The Three Mesquiteers (Harry Carey, Hoot Gibson, Guinn Williams) fight a gambler and his henchmen for a ranch. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Yellow Dust
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A prospector goes undercover to clear his name of robbery before he can lay claim to a mother lode of gold. (Western) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Arizonian
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A marshal, trying to end lawlessness and protect his brother and sweetheart, fights it out with a gang of crooks. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cimarron
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1889, adventurous lawyer and newspaper editor Yancey Cravat (Richard Dix) convinces his genteel wife, Sabra (Irene Dunne), to join him in the rush to populate Osage, Oklahoma. After they begin to settle into the community, Yancey leaves to go further west. Alone, Sabra inherits his editorial duties and struggles to bring civilization to the rough frontier town. Over a tumultuous 40 years, the couple are repeatedly separated and reunited as Oklahoma makes its long journey to statehood. (Western) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ghost Valley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A crooked judge (Mitchell Harris) unwittingly hires the heir to a gold mine to scare his cousin (Merna Kennedy) into selling the property. (Western, Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Annie Oakley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Expert markswoman Annie Oakley (Barbara Stanwyck) leaves her backwoods home to challenge New York's vaudeville sharpshooter, Toby Walker (Preston Foster). Toby is skeptical of Annie's skill, but although she purposely loses their contest, the business partner of Buffalo Bill Cody (Moroni Olsen) realizes her potential. Cody builds an act for his Wild West show around Annie and Toby's rivalry, but it is threatened by their acquaintance with native Chief Sitting Bull, and a challenge for Toby. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Scarlet River
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An actor (Tom Keene) on the set of a cowboy movie rescues a rancher (Dorothy Wilson) from her foreman (Creighton Chaney). (Western) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Carl Laemmle
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The extraordinary life story of Carl Laemmle, the German-Jewish immigrant who founded Universal Pictures and saved over 300 Jewish families from Nazi Germany. (Documentary) - 2019

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Frankenstein
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation. (Horror) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Invisible Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him. (Science fiction) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Black Cat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor. (Horror) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Posing for a portrait, Dorian Gray (Hurd Hatfield) talks with Lord Henry Wotton (George Sanders), who says that men should pursue their sensual longings, but laments that only the young get to do so. Taken with the idea, Dorian imagines a scenario in which the painting will age as he stays youthful. His wish comes true, and his boyish looks aid him as he indulges his every whim. But when a stunning revelation forces him to see what he's become, Dorian faces some very dangerous questions. (Horror) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Beast With Five Fingers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Astrologist Hilary Cummins (Peter Lorre) works as a personal assistant to the eccentric and mostly paralyzed pianist, Francis Ingram (Victor Francen). A nurse, Julie Holden (Andrea King) also lives at the Italian villa to help care for Ingram, who plays the piano with only his undamaged left hand. Following a visit from a scam artist (Robert Alda), Ingram crashes down the stairs to his death -- and a plague of bizarre events ensues that are attributed to the musician's disembodied left hand. (Horror) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Science fiction) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Science fiction) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Lost City - The Tunnel of Flame
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes. (Drama, Adventure)

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Gillespie's Criminal Case
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Leonard Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) presses prison officials about one of his former patients, convicted murderer Roy Todwell (John Craven), trying to convince them that Todwell is dangerously insane and should be committed to a mental hospital. Meanwhile, rival doctors Randall Red Adams (Van Johnson) and Lee Wong How (Keye Luke) attempt to convince embittered veteran Alvin Peterson (William Lundigan) to accept and overcome the disability he received in the attack on Pearl Harbor. (Drama) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - The Case of the Stuttering Pig
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A monster targets Porky and his family for their inheritance. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1937-10-30

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - Claws for Alarm
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Porky and Sylvester stay the night in a big scary mansion. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1954-05-22

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Golden Eighties
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Three women, Lili, Mado and Pascale, compete for Robby's attention until he suddenly proposes to Mado. As the wedding date arrives, Lili tries one more time for Robby's affections. (Comedy) - 1986

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sapphire
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A pregnant college student named Sapphire Robbins (Yvonne Buckingham) is murdered in London's Hampstead Heath. When police superintendent Robert Hazard (Nigel Patrick) discovers that the victim was a light-skinned black woman passing as white, it upends his initial assumptions. Hazard and his openly racist assistant (Michael Craig) explore the city's racially tense underground jazz scene as they interview suspects, including Sapphire's white fiancé (Paul Massie). (Mystery) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Candidate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Without a candidate to run for the senate seat against admired Republican Crocker Jarmon (Don Porter), campaign manager Marvin Lucas (Peter Boyle) recruits leftist lawyer Bill McKay (Robert Redford). McKay's appearance piques the public's interest, and gradually Lucas pushes McKay toward a more centrist message. As McKay's original and honest platform gets watered down, his popularity increases so much that he is running even with Jarmon as Election Day approaches. (Comedy drama) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: American Graffiti
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the last day of summer vacation in 1962, friends Curt (Richard Dreyfuss), Steve (Ronny Howard), Terry (Charles Martin Smith) and John (Paul Le Mat) cruise the streets of small-town California while a mysterious disc jockey (Wolfman Jack) spins classic rock'n'roll tunes. It's the last night before their grown-up lives begin, and Steve's high-school sweetheart, a hot-to-trot blonde, a bratty adolescent and a disappearing angel in a Thunderbird provide all the excitement they can handle. (Comedy drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sullivan's Travels
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Hollywood director's desire to produce a film about real people and human suffering leads him on an odyssey as a hobo. - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Contempt
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A screenwriter's wife (Brigitte Bardot) becomes angry with her husband when he fails to defend her honor after a producer (Jack Palance) makes a pass at her. - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The House on Telegraph Hill
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Polish survivor (Valentina Cortesa) of a Nazi death camp assumes another woman's identity and son in San Francisco. - 1951

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E22 The Time Monster: Episode 2 The Doctor tracks the Master down to the Newton Institute. There, after a disastrous attempt to summon Kronos, the Master prepares to use TOMTIT again.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E23 The Time Monster: Episode 3 Krasis, High Priest of Atlantis has been summoned by the Master to help him find the crystal of Kronos. The Master uses TOMTIT to summon threats from the past to attack UNIT.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E24 The Time Monster: Episode 4 As UNIT approaches, the Master leaves for Atlantis in his TARDIS. However, the Doctor is not far behind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E25 The Time Monster: Episode 5 Arriving in Atlantis, the Master seduces the beautiful Queen Galleia so that he might possess the crystal of Kronos. But it is protected by a guardian who is half man, half beast.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E26 The Time Monster: Episode 6 With the crystal of Kronos in his possession, the Master prepares to release the Chronovore. The Doctor is powerless to stop his nemesis as the end of Atlantis approaches.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E12 The Sea Devils: Episode 4 The Doctor attempts to persuade Captain Hart of the danger that the Master represents. Eager to make contact with the Sea Devils, the Doctor journey’s to the sea bed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E13 The Sea Devils: Episode 5 The Doctor is captured by the Sea Devils and taken to their undersea base. There he tries to make peace with the creatures, but his efforts are thwarted by the Navy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E14 The Sea Devils: Episode 6 The Sea Devils come to the surface and attack the Naval base. The Doctor is forced to create a machine that will awaken the creatures across the entire world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E15 The Mutants: Episode 1 The Time Lords send the Doctor to a Skybase above the planet Solos in the 30th Century. The Marshal of the Skybase is determined to prevent Solos achieving independence from Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E16 The Mutants: Episode 2 Fearing Jo has died in Solos's hostile environment, the Doctor is forced to work with the scientist, Jaeger, to make the planet's atmosphere breathable for humans.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E17 The Mutants: Episode 3 Ky opens the message box but cannot understand the ancient carved tablets inside. The Marshal seals the Doctor and his friends in the caves and prepares to gas them to death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E18 The Mutants: Episode 4 The Doctor deduces the true meaning of the ancient carvings and must brave the intense radiation of the thaesium caves to retrieve a crystal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E19 The Mutants: Episode 5 With Jo held prisoner, the Doctor is forced to work for the Marshal. The Earth Investigator’s ship prepares to dock at Skybase.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E20 The Mutants: Episode 6 Despite the Doctor's arguments, the Earth Investigator reinstates the Marshal as commander of Skybase. Bombarded by thaesium radiation, Ky begins an incredible transformation.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Live At The Malthouse
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Dane Simpson - Didgeridoozy Gut-bustingly funny stories, fun facts + big laughs - a comedic ode to one of the world's oldest wind instruments. Discover the what/why/how of the didge and have a hell of a lot of fun along the way.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Arrested Development
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E13 The Untethered Sole Buster's brief appearance in a TV weather report puts the Bluths back in hot water, but Michael has a plan involving his son's definitely real company.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Arrested Development
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E14 Saving for Arraignment Day As the trial kicks off, the Guilty Guys throw the family for a loop. Lucille learns surprising news about Dusty. George Michael plots a distraction.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Arrested Development
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E15 Courting Disasters George and Lucille overestimate their new lawyer's expertise in the courtroom. Two familiar faces testify, and a video sheds more light on the case.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E19 Fire In The Belly Carter's sneaky moves to get more surgical work threatens his relationship with Harper. Peter faces the fallout from his altercation with Doug, Susan battles Chloe in court, and Shep begins exhibiting uncontrolled hostility.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E297 Episode 297 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E5 Charlie Charlie is getting a reputation at school for being the class clown, but a chat with Lee reveals that he is trying to impress a little girl in his form. Charlie soon turns over a new leaf and enters a writing competition.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E2 Gyles Brandreth, Karen Gibson, Sophie Cookson In this second heat, nine artists are challenged to create a portrait of one of three celebrities: writer and broadcaster Gyles Brandreth, conductor and Kingdom Choir founder Karen Gibson and actor Sophie Cookson.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E6 Gary Anthony Williams Aisha Tyler hosts another hilarious episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Gary Anthony Williams.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E18 Week in Review When Eddie comes home with lice and infects others in the family, Louis leaves it to Jessica to clean up the mess. Meanwhile, Eddie's classmates suffer the consequences when he welches on a bet he made with his teacher.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ABC News Update
ABCMESydney.au.description: E85 Sunday 25 October 2026 The headlines from ABC News, updating you on the day's top stories from across Australia and around the world.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Cockneys It's all about cockney rhyming slang. Any flamencos (dancers, answers) given in Pyong (yang, slang) score Barney (Rubble, double) points. Joining Stephen Fry are Phill Jupitus, Bill Bailey, Rory McGrath and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 The Prince Of Masks Prince Cyrus needs help defending his village from pirates.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 A Scare to Remember Aunt Lydia's favourite author is coming to stay in his usual room in the hotel. A room the kids just threw a raging party in and cleaned up in a rush.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 Hank And The Real Boy Hank is tired of his limbs being used to make everyone's life easier. Mavis and the kids try to help him better attach his body parts, but they accidentally go a bit too far and somehow, someway, turn Hank into a real boy!

ABCMESydney.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 The Case Of The Very Lost Notebook When Maudie loses her beloved notebook Ezra, Ava and Kyle band together to reunite their friend with her most prized possession.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E23 Rainy Day Daydream Jake's imagination runs wild and Finn has to stop it before it kills them.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E23 Citizen Tabes After accidentally wounding an animal, Ranger Tabes quits her job.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E33 Standards & Practices The Titans' negative behaviour is giving superheroes a bad name, so they must learn proper conduct to be good role models for kids.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E29 Bottle Episode The Titans get trapped in a giant bottle in the living room.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E16 Hack-San What if Marinette had no choice but to leave Paris on the day when Shadow Moth decided to create a new supervillain?

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad (Cutdowns)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Pokemon Legends: Z-A Synopsis.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E25 To Where and Back Again (1) Without the help of Twilight Sparkle and the Mane Six, Starlight Glimmer assembles an unlikely team of heroes to defend Equestria from the return of one of its greatest threats.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 Scooby on Ice! Scooby Doo and the gang are in Austria for the International Ice Games and meet Tara Lipinski.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Deep
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E23 Bloop The Nektons are trying to identify a unique life form. They've never seen it - they've only heard its sound: \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mystery Lane
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E24 The Phantom of Linford Street Athena calls on Clever and Bro when she and her scientist master are attacked by the phantom of her master's partner who died in an accident twenty years ago and who now threatens to seek vengeance.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E10 He's Just Not Here Right Now Oscar and Hedgehog encounter New Jersey's most famous piece of folklore.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E24 The Corridor Outside 6 E When Max and Elsa, the weird twins, suddenly leave class without a note, everyone speculates as to why they disappeared. Before long, a ridiculous rumour chain is circulating.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E32 Cyril's Crazy Day Because he does everything in the submarine, Cyril cracks: he now thinks he's a little fairy who solves all problems, even if it means putting himself in danger.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E45 BBCYFSHIPBDAY Beast Boy and Cyborg celebrate the birthday of their friendship.

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Isobel and Gem Rank Teamwork Games! Join Isobel and Gem as they rank 4 top-tier teamwork games! With Overcooked 2, Unrailed! Moving Out 2 and Unravel Two in the mix, how will they possibly choose which is best!?

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Next Step: Cheer ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 Choreo Camp During Choreo Camp, Olive tries to minimise tensions with Layla, Kenzie tries to keep a secret from Melody, and Heath tries to one-up Jax.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Kiki's Delivery Service ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: All young witches must leave their families on the night of a full moon and fly off into the wide world to learn their craft. When that night comes for Kiki, she embarks on her new journey with her sarcastic black cat, Jiji.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E7 Wartime Bunker & Library Van Whilst renovating their garage, Steve and Marie never dreamt that they would find a World War Two bunker hidden underneath their garden. They decide to revolutionise the damp and dark space into a home office.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E6 Marriage Guidance Anna tells Lucy that she and Toby are doing marriage counselling, and advises Lucy to try it out too. If Lee and Lucy's marriage wasn't in trouble before they go to marriage counselling, it is by the time they leave.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Midsomer Murders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E5 Saints And Sinners The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby & DS Nelson soon realise that it's not only skeletons that have been long buried.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E19 Fire In The Belly Carter's sneaky moves to get more surgical work threatens his relationship with Harper. Peter faces the fallout from his altercation with Doug, Susan battles Chloe in court, and Shep begins exhibiting uncontrolled hostility.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 You Lost Me At, \ Ben Hurley, Rhiannon McCall, Jacquie Brown and our reigning champ from episode four try to take each other down with their varied spelling knowledge. Guy throws at them games like: Flags, A Decent Proposal and Social Media.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Antidotes Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Danny Baker, Jo Brand and Howard Goodall.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E20 Episode 20 Our favourite nutritionist, Simone, joins Laura in the market as they put together a delicious and nutritious Salmon Poke Bowl.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E2 Mackay Isaac Region Hayden ventures off the beaten track into the Mackay Isaac region, discovering pristine landscapes, remote fishing spots, and remarkable food producers who make this hidden corner of Australia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E10 Episode 10 Here's what's coming up on today's show. Gabriel Gates bakes us a sublime Apple and Calvados Cake. Justine has the perfect Cappuccino Mousse.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E15 Episode 15 Laura whips up mushroom curry, Thai beef salad and manicotti, while Catherine serves Persian-style potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E13 Episode 13 Rick and Chalky enjoy Irish hospitality, sampling herb celery around Strangford Lough, and monkfish and mussels in Southern Ireland. Fresh oysters and organic kale complete this Irish culinary tour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E44 Episode 44 There's brulee and then there's Earl Grey and Berry Tea Brulee with Rhubarb Compote: guest Jeremy Bentley gets creative with this one. Justine makes her winter warmer Chicken and Mushroom Cottage pie.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E77 Simple & Scrumptious It's a night of simple and scrumptious food, as Adam is joined by two sensational chefs, Zoe Birch from Greasy Zoe's and Chung Jae Lee from Seoul Sisters.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 West Flores Mountains: Manggarai Culture And Cooking High in the mountains of Flores, Lara Lee discovers ancestral food traditions, soul-stirring hospitality and the delicious charm of slow food from bamboo feasts & barefoot farming to pineapple sambal.

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17
