wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. discoverywest.us.title: Moonshiners
discoverywest.us.description: S16 E01 Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

discoverywest.us.title: Moonshiners
discoverywest.us.description: S16 E02 Stranger Danger Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

discoverywest.us.title: Moonshiners
discoverywest.us.description: S16 E03 Mine and Shine Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

discoverywest.us.title: Moonshiners
discoverywest.us.description: S16 E04 Digger Knows Best Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S05 E02 Gold Today, Gone Tomorrow When nuggets dry up on a couple's mine, the guys must crack the case, is it the miners or the mine?; battling a faulty operation, they build a new shaker table and a never-before-seen sluice scissor mechanism, making everything out of nothing.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S05 E01 Pipe Dreams Freddy and Juan face off at a hard rock mine spanning three elevations at 4,000 feet in the Cascades; battling impenetrable rock, the guys devise an innovative 180-foot chute featuring a spiral concentrator in their first Washington state rescue.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
discoverywest.us.description: S05 E06 Shake Rattle and Gold A BC miner fights to set up a legacy mine for his son, located beside the gold-rich Fraser River; Freddy and Juan resurrect a boneyard shaker and Franken-build an entire wash plant to triple production, saving a father's dream.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E01 Living Life on the Edge A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E02 The Tunnel of Chaos The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; Mountain Recovery and Stauffer's Towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : The Most Gold Wins
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E01 Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : A Midas Mess
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E02 Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : Diagnosing Rick
discoverywest.us.description: S17 E03 Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

fxm.us.title: Aliens
fxm.us.description: After floating in space for 57 years, Lt. Ripley's shuttle is found by a deep space salvage team. Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine-year-old girl named Newt. But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 1986

fxm.us.title: Alien 3
fxm.us.description: Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) is the only survivor when she crash lands on Fiorina 161, a bleak wasteland inhabited by former inmates of the planet's maximum security prison. Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

fxm.us.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
fxm.us.description: When a UFO lands in Washington, D.C., bearing a message for Earth's leaders, all of humanity stands still. Klaatu has come on behalf of alien life who have been watching Cold War-era nuclear proliferation on Earth. But it is Klaatu's soft-spoken robot Gort that presents a more immediate threat to onlookers. A single mother and her son teach the world about peace and tolerance in this moral fable, ousting the tanks and soldiers that greet the alien's arrival. (Science fiction) - 1951

fxm.us.title: Surf Party
fxm.us.description: An Arizona gal (Patricia Morrow) and her friends enjoy sun, sand and romance when they drive out to California for a surfing vacation. (Musical comedy, Romance) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Champagne Charlie
fxm.us.description: A young heiress (Helen Wood) becomes the prime suspect in the murder of a smooth gambler (Paul Cavanagh). (Mystery, Crime drama) - 1936

fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Race With the Devil
fxm.us.description: Roger (Peter Fonda), his friend Frank (Warren Oates), and their wives (Lara Parker, Loretta Swit) are heading from San Antonio to the wilderness of rural Texas for some off-road motocross. What they find instead is a Satanic cult sacrifice, and they are unfortunate enough to be caught observing the ritual. Naturally, this doesn't sit too well with the cult members. Now Roger and Frank are on the run from what is apparently a very sizable Texan Satanist community. (Horror) - 1975

fxm.us.title: The Terrorists
fxm.us.description: Attempting to secure the release of political prisoners, a terrorist group, led by the fierce Ray Petrie (Ian McShane), takes over a British plane. Tough Scandinavian operative Nils Tahlvik (Sean Connery) is sent in to deal with the armed men and free the aircraft's passengers. Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Gleaming the Cube
fxm.us.description: A California skateboarder (Christian Slater) solves and avenges the death of his adopted Vietnamese brother. (Action) - 1988

fxm.us.title: Hitman: Agent 47
fxm.us.description: Genetically engineered from conception to be the perfect killing machine, he's the culmination of decades of research, endowed with unprecedented strength, speed, stamina and intelligence. Known only as Agent 47 (Rupert Friend), his latest target is a corporation that plans to unlock the secret of his past to create an army of killers even more powerful than him. With help from a young woman, the elite assassin confronts revelations about his own origins in an epic battle with his deadliest foe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller, Mystery) - 2015

fxm.us.title: Unbreakable
fxm.us.description: David Dunn (Bruce Willis) is the sole survivor of a devastating train wreck. Elijah Price (Samuel L. Jackson) is a mysterious stranger who offers a bizarre explanation as to why David escaped without a single scratch -- an explanation which threatens to change David's family and his life forever. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Drama, Science fiction) - 2000

fxm.us.title: The Watch
fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

fxm.us.title: The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen
fxm.us.description: A team of extraordinary figures culled from great adventure literature, including Allan Quatermain, vampiress Mina Harker from Dracula, the Invisible Man, Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, an American Secret Service agent named Sawyer, Captain Nemo and Dorian Gray, are called to stop a villain intent on turning the nations of the world against one another. (Fantasy, Action) - 2003

fxm.us.title: Machete
fxm.us.description: After nearly being killed during a violent fight with a powerful drug lord, a former Mexican Federale known as Machete roams Texas streets as a vigilante and sometime day-laborer. Hired to perform a covert hit, he is double-crossed and forced to go on the run. Machete may be down, but not out, and he carves a path of blood, bullets and broken hearts in his quest to settle the score. (Action) - 2010

fxm.us.title: The Fury
fxm.us.description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza (Kirk Douglas) from his son, Robin (Andrew Stevens), the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress (John Cassavetes), who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian (Amy Irving), a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin. (Thriller, Horror) - 1978

fxm.us.title: Wee Willie Winkie
fxm.us.description: With her widowed mother (June Lang), precocious Priscilla (Shirley Temple) travels to India to live with her grandfather, Col. Williams (C. Aubrey Smith). A stern officer in the British army, the colonel makes it clear that a military garrison isn't any place for a child. Priscilla proves otherwise, befriending tenderhearted Sgt. MacDuff (Victor McLaglen), getting caught up in the plot of a rebel leader (Cesar Romero) and charming everyone in sight. (Comedy drama) - 1937

fxm.us.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
fxm.us.description: Defying her conventional in-laws, young widow Lucy Muir (Gene Tierney) leaves London with her young daughter and moves away for a quieter life in a secluded seaside cottage. Lucy discovers the ghost of the deceased former owner, sea captain Daniel Gregg (Rex Harrison), is haunting the house, but gathers the courage to stand up to him, and woman and ghost become friends. Faced with dwindling means of support, Lucy agrees to the Captain's challenge to write his colorful life story. (Fantasy) - 1947

fxm.us.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
fxm.us.description: Three hopeful American secretaries visiting Italy -- newcomer Maria (Maggie McNamara), romance-seeking Anita (Jean Peters) and the more mature Frances (Dorothy McGuire) -- fling their coins into Rome's Trevi Fountain, each making a wish. Soon, Maria is pursued by a dashing prince (Louis Jourdan), Anita finds herself involved with a forbidden coworker (Rossano Brazzi), and Frances receives a surprising proposal from her boss (Clifton Webb). All three women vow to one day return to Rome. (Romance) - 1954

fxm.us.title: Love Is a Many Splendored Thing
fxm.us.description: In Hong Kong in 1949, Mark Elliott is an American reporter covering the Chinese civil war. Undergoing a trial separation from his wife, he meets the beautiful Dr. Han Suyin, a widowed physician from mainland China. As the pair fall in love, they encounter disapproval from both her family and his friends about their interracial romance. Although the film was a commercial success upon release, the casting of Jones in an Asian role has since been criticized. (Romance) - 1955

fxm.us.title: An Affair to Remember
fxm.us.description: A man and a woman have a romance while on a cruise from Europe to New York. Despite being engaged to other people, both agree to reunite at the top of the Empire State Building in six months. However, an unfortunate accident keeps her from the reunion, and he fears that she has married or does not love him anymore. (Romance) - 1957

fxm.us.title: I Still Believe
fxm.us.description: The true-life story of Christian music star Jeremy Camp and his journey of love and loss, which attempts to prove there is always hope. (Biography, Drama, Romance, Music, Rock) - 2020

bbcamerica.us.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
bbcamerica.us.description: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out. (Horror, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1996

bbcamerica.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Earth's Great Seasons - Autumn
bbcamerica.us.description: With winter fast approaching, life has to get ready and that means feeding up while you can, fighting for the last chance to breed and rushing to grow up before the cold returns. (Nature, Documentary) - 2017-06-23

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II - Macaque
bbcamerica.us.description: High in the mountains of Morocco lives a descendant of a long line of macaque rulers who has been in charge of her troop for many winters - one of the longest recorded reigns of an alpha - but this year is likely to be her last. (Nature, Documentary) - 2025-12-07

bbcamerica.us.title: Cujo
bbcamerica.us.description: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

bbcamerica.us.title: Once Bitten
bbcamerica.us.description: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms. (Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: The Lost Boys
bbcamerica.us.description: Teenage brothers Michael (Jason Patric) and Sam (Corey Haim) move with their mother (Dianne Wiest) to a small town in northern California. While the younger Sam meets a pair of kindred spirits in geeky comic-book nerds Edward (Corey Feldman) and Alan (Jamison Newlander), the angst-ridden Michael soon falls for Star (Jami Gertz) -- who turns out to be in thrall to David (Kiefer Sutherland), leader of a local gang of vampires. Sam and his new friends must save Michael and Star from the undead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1987

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Blue Planet II - Coral Reefs

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Blue Planet II - Green Seas

5starmax.us.title: Switch
5starmax.us.description: Steve Brooks (Perry King), a sexist womanizer, is killed by a group of his angry former lovers. In heaven, he makes a bargain with God for redemption and agrees to return to Earth. Once there, he must have a sincere relationship with a female and make her fall in love with him. If not, Steve's soul will become the property of the devil (Bruce Martyn Payne). But the devil hedges his bet, and Steve is reincarnated as a woman named Amanda Brooks (Ellen Barkin). (Fantasy) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Son of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

5starmax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
5starmax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Catfish
5starmax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Man
5starmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International

They're looking for a place with outdoor space for their dogs, but she doesn't mind stretching their budget to get what she wants.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America

hgtvwest.us.title: Fix My Frankenhouse

hgtvwest.us.title: Fix My Frankenhouse

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S17 E10 Melbourne Beach Hub-Life Living most of the time on the road in their RV, a couple's using an inheritance to find a place near the beach in Melbourne, Fla.; they look for a hub where they can rest and store their gear.

He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is. (Western) - 1935

Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Not Your Nonna's Risotto

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils

tastemade.us.title: Worth the Hype - Cubanos, Empanadas, & Smoked Beef Rib in Miami

arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E25 The Mr. Almost Episode When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E34 The Secret Episode Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E31 The Kwandanegaba Children's Fund Episode Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online; when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E21 The V.I.P. Tickets Episode Suzanne is furious when Nick invites Martin and not her to a baseball game; Kevin and Lindsey try to win tickets to Rihanna's Los Angeles concert.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E01 The Staycation Episode When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best vacation ever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E23 The Compatibility Test Episode Suzanne meets a relationship adviser and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E26 The Big Loan Episode Confusion ensues when Suzanne asks Marilyn for a loan in an attempt to keep her birthday present a secret for Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E15 The Control Issue Episode When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go; the family realizes they need Suzanne's controlling ways to run a successful household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E48 The Concussion Episode After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours; to avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E19 The Disney Episode Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World; Suzanne has to miss the family's first vacation.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E04 The 22 Episode When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E30 The Silent Treatment Episode Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E02 The Thief Episode Nick refuses to give Lindsey money for a concert, so Lindsey resorts to stealing sixty dollars from Gigi's purse; when Gigi discovers the missing money, she blames Kevin for the theft.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E17 The Fall of Troy Episode When Troy provokes a school bully, Kevin strikes up a friendship with his tormentor to avoid a beat down; Kevin soon faces a difficult decision.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E10 The Get-Together Episode Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect; Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E43 The Timeshare Episode Marilyn begins to date a younger man, but Nick doubts his true intentions. Meanwhile, Kevin breaks his arm.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E04 The Nick's Manny Pedi Episode When Suzanne crashes a night with Nick and his boys, Nick decides he needs to pay her back by showing up for spa treatments with Suzanne and her girlfriends to show her what it is like.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E27 The Family Portrait Episode Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E34 The Lindsey Goes Vegan Episode When Lindsey decides to adopt a vegan lifestyle, Suzanne convinces Nick they should go vegan as well; they come to regret this decision when they learn the extent of Lindsey's dedication.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E32 The Blockbuster Movie Episode Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E13 The Whose Card Is It Anyway Episode Suzanne and Nick go on a "People's Court TV" show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E27 The Lindsey Gets High Episode Lindsey freaks out when a friend offers her a drug; she gets a lesson on drugs from former child-star Todd Bridges who takes her on a wild ride.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E22 The Lindsey Dances Episode Lindsey auditions to dance in a P-Nut music video, but considers quitting when she discovers that the choreographer is a drill sergeant and the other dancers are far more experienced.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E37 The Satchel Pagge Episode Nick is looking for a man with a voice of gold; Suzanne loses Gigi's expensive sweater.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E24 The House Sitter's Episode When the house sitters next door begin acting irresponsibly, Nick and Suzanne question if they are being played for fools.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E21 The Nick Gets Jealous Episode Nick asks Suzanne to help pro basketball player Ray Savage plan a children's charity event, but gets worried when he learns of Ray's reputation as a womanizer.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E25 The Nick Gets Promoted Episode Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E52 The Spelling Bee Episode Nick meets a famous actor and shadows him to prepare for an upcoming role; Kevin studies for a spelling bee.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E47 The Wrong Way Episode Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event; Lindsey prepares a feast.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E06 The Gold Party Episode Marilyn throws a gold party; Nick discovers Suzanne's wedding ring is not actually real and sets out to have a real ring made before she learns the truth, while Suzanne thinks she has lost her wedding ring forever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E10 The Father's Day Episode Nick is disappointed when Frank crashes his Father's Day trip; when an elevator stops, the men are forced to have a meaningful heart-to-heart.

arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E07 The Suzanne Gets Arrested Episode When Suzanne's stubborn need to argue her point gets her arrested, she starts to change her ways, but not necessarily for the better.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E18 The Mother's-In-Law Episode When Suzanne's Mother comes to visit, she attacks Nick for being an inadequate husband, while hiding her true feelings of her own husband's inadequacy, until Suzanne and Terrence press her.

arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E39 The Inappropriate Website Episode Nick pulls up an adult website at work on accident; Suzanne stays at home for a couch delivery; Lindsey studies for a Shakespeare test.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A scientist (Scott Bairstow) finds a monster that devours its prey in the deserts of South Africa. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here

At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow. moviesphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
shadesofblack.us.description: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1995

shadesofblack.us.title: Soda Cracker
shadesofblack.us.description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner. (Crime drama) - 1989

shadesofblack.us.title: Foxy Brown
shadesofblack.us.description: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother. (Crime drama) - 1974

shadesofblack.us.title: Blacula
shadesofblack.us.description: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail. (Horror) - 1972

shadesofblack.us.title: The Forgiven
shadesofblack.us.description: During his life sentence in post-apartheid South Africa, brutal murderer Piet Blomfeld seeks redemption through meetings with Archbishop Desmond Tutu. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shadesofblack.us.title: The Best of Enemies
shadesofblack.us.description: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever. (Historical drama) - 2019
A father hides his wife's drug addiction from his daughter. (Drama) - 2013

shadesofblack.us.title: Pride
shadesofblack.us.description: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships. (Drama) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: Soul Men
shadesofblack.us.description: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater. (Comedy) - 2008

outlaw.us.title: Hell on the Border
outlaw.us.description: A former slave becomes the first black deputy U.S. Marshal west of the Mississippi River in the late 1800s. (Western) - 2019

outlaw.us.title: Montana
outlaw.us.description: Aussie shepherd Morgan Lane (Errol Flynn) moves all the way to Montana in hopes of finding the perfect terrain for raising his sheep, but the local ranchers aren't keen on sharing their land with outsiders. Before long, Morgan clashes with powerful cattleman Rodney Ackroyd, and their rivalry is only intensified when Ackroyd's fiancée, Maria (Alexis Smith), has eyes for Morgan. However, her sympathies still lie with her lover, and it seems that only a gunfight can settle the conflict. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: Wild Stallion
outlaw.us.description: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: Wild Rovers
outlaw.us.description: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest. (Western) - 1971

outlaw.us.title: McLintock!
outlaw.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

outlaw.us.title: Cahill, United States Marshal
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. marshal (John Wayne) neglects his two sons and finds them mixed up with an outlaw (George Kennedy) in a bank robbery. (Western) - 1973

outlaw.us.title: Springfield Rifle
outlaw.us.description: During the Civil War, Union forces stationed in Colorado are hampered by raiders who have been stealing their horses as they travel through the mountains. When several commanding officers begin to suspect a traitor is revealing troop movements, Maj. Lex Kearny (Gary Cooper) goes undercover to investigate. However, the assignment strains Kearny's relationship with his wife, Erin (Phyllis Thaxter), after he chooses to continue the operation instead of searching for their runaway son. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: Best of the Badmen
outlaw.us.description: After the North defeats the South, Union Maj. Jeff Clanton heads to Missouri to provide the Confederacy's Quantrill's Raiders a chance to claim allegiance to the Union, thereby clearing their wanted status. But standing in Clanton's way are the corrupt lawmen Joad and Fowler, who would rather keep the men outlaws to collect the reward on their heads. After Joad and Fowler frame Clanton for murder, he manages to escape, becoming an outlaw himself. (Western) - 1951

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
outtvproud.us.description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward). (Horror, Western, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
outtvproud.us.description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal. (Action, Horror) - 2010

outtvproud.us.title: Bitch Slap
outtvproud.us.description: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change. (Action) - 2009

outtvproud.us.title: The Inspection
outtvproud.us.description: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022

outtvproud.us.title: Chick Fight

"The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2011-02-18

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
tastemadetravel.us.description: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
tastemadetravel.us.description: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Art of the Egg
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Famous Pastes of Spices
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together. (Cooking) - 2024-02-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Master Pasta Maker of Puglia, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: TV and radio host Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera or poor man's cooking. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-01-23

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 Think Outside the Kitchen Stephanie is a new mom who finds joy in cooking because of the memories she made in India growing up. Now, she is determined to pass those memories on. Ellen knows Stephanie is a super fan and is determined not to let her down.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Organization Over Everything Andrew and Leah are the coolest, quirky couple in Eagle Rock. While they love their Spanish-style home, the kitchen is out of place in the worst way. With a small budget and big dreams, Ellen will have to get really creative to please this couple.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 A Baker's Dozen Problems Kandis is a home baker with a booming gluten-free business, but her tiny, chaotic kitchen is crumbling under pressure. With help from Ellen & a tight budget, she hopes to transform it into a pro space that supports her dream & her family's needs.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Vlad & Olga's Culinary Clash Vlad & Olga's cramped condo kitchen is straining their marriage. He wants function, she wants minimalism-& DIY fixes only cause fights. With no pantry, messy drawers & a 4-year-old, they call in Ellen to save their space-& their sanity.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Designing Joy Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 A Chef's Dream Kitchen Culinary event producer Caryl Chinn's 1970s kitchen is a design disaster, embarrassing her during tastings with top chefs; with broken appliances, wasted space & clutter everywhere, she's counting on Ellen to deliver a kitchen fit for work & play.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Elevated Farmhouse Laura and James have four kids and one on the way! They have a tiny kitchen with the cooking output of a busy restaurant! Ellen adores this family and is determined to give them more than they could have ever hoped.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Perfect Patio Pizza, Please Stephanie & John are back-but this time, the makeover's headed outside. With baby #2 on the way & a toddler who's asleep by 7, indoor cooking is off-limits. They need Ellen to transform their sad patio into a pizza paradise!

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 From Burnout to Cook-Off Barrie & Morgan are new homeowners & expecting parents. Barrie runs a catering business from home, but with bad storage, a leaky stove hood & no flow, her creativity's stalling & she's eyeing a rental kitchen to cope. Can Ellen save it?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 An English Manor in the Golden State Kathy and her husband John are relocating from New York City to sunny California. They're looking for a house that's closer to their family. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 The Educators' Dream Castle Michael and Lynne are looking for a new home for when they get married. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pacific Palisades, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 The Ultimate Home for Art Lovers George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Palo Alto, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 An Elevated Lower Level Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Old Plan to Open Floor Plan Sarah and Mark's house needs to be brought into the 21st century so Nicole and Caffery will create a new, timeless and functional design for their family; real estate pro Karina needs help morphing a virtually staged listing into a real showstopper.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Two Sisters, One Home Sisters Leandra and Alayna recently inherited their childhood home. So they've asked Nicole and Caffrey to transform it into a fresh, contemporary space while still honoring the past.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Speakeasy to Me Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Elevated Oasis With renters in the basement, Sarah and Shawn have nowhere to go but up to find some tranquility. Nicole and Caffrey take on their dated bedroom and ensuite to create an elevated oasis.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E04 Property Brothers: Kevin and Shirley Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E08 The Da Vinci Conspiracy Examining Leonardo da Vinci's paintings, sketches and journals look for knowledge of otherworldly technology and aliens.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E10 Aliens and Dinosaurs Ancient alien theorists wonder about the depiction of a stegosaurus in Angkor Wat, the world's largest ancient religious temple, and ask how the ancients could have known about dinosaurs.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S11 E05 The Visionaries Theorists suggest that extraterrestrials have been communicating with mathematicians and engineers through the universal language of mathematics and binary code, influencing Nikolai Fyodorov and other visionaries to advocate for space exploration.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S12 E06 The Science Wars Archaeologists and anthropologists make discoveries that receive no notice because they don't fit into the accepted scientific paradigm, such as an ancient hammer found in Texas or elongated skulls found on nearly every continent.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S12 E07 City of the Gods Researchers suggest that the ancient site of Teotihuacan in central Mexico was once home to a highly advanced, perhaps extraterrestrial, civilization; excavations at Teotihuacan have unearthed discoveries out of place in the ancient world.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S16 E07 Impossible Artifacts Strange ancient objects that leave archaeologists at a loss could suggest that an advanced extraterrestrial civilization existed on Earth for thousands of years.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S16 E08 The Space Travelers Humankind's most profound achievement is blasting off into the stars; what humans might learn by venturing out farther into space.

classica.us.title: Haydn - Sinfonie Nr. 45, Abschiedssinfonie
classica.us.description: Unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen spielt das Orchester Sinfonia Rotterdam Haydns 45. Sinfonie in der Nieuwe Kerk (Neue Kirche) in Den Haag. Das Stück trägt nach einer lustigen Anekdote den Spitznamen Abschiedssinfonie. (Special, Music) - 2019-07-02

classica.us.title: Gara Garayev: Herbstsonaten
classica.us.description: Pianist Vadim Repin und Bratschist Murad Hüseynov interpretieren Gara Garayevs Bratschensonate und 24 Präludien für Klavier. Aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Geschrieben und inszeniert von Juliette Swierczewski und aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Obwohl Garayev ein Komponist des 20. Jahrhunderts ist, trägt seine Musik Anklänge an die romantische Musik. Murad, der Hauptakteur, verkörpert eine jener von Einsamkeit geprägten Figuren, die in den romantischen Gemälden von Friedrich zu finden sind. (Family, Special, Music, Classical) - 2018-08-03

classica.us.title: Bach - Partita Nr. 2 und Sonate Nr. 3
classica.us.description: Die Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt zwei Solowerke für die Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für die Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-04-21

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-22

classica.us.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
classica.us.description: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus. (Special, Documentary) - 2016-05-01

classica.us.title: Brahms - Klarinettensonate Nr. 2, Op. 120
classica.us.description: Die 1984 geschriebenen Klarinettensonaten op. 120 sind die letzten Kammermusikstücke, die Johannes Brahms vor seinem Tod komponiert hat. (Special) - 2026-07-14

classica.us.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
classica.us.description: Das Armenische Nationalphilharmonische Orchester führt Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14 auf. Dieses ist unter der Leitung von Dirigent Eduard Topchjan. Komponiert wurde das Stück von Hector Berlioz im Jahr 1830. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-03-05

classica.us.title: Barocke Chormusik von Bach, Schütz u.a
classica.us.description: Die amarcordplus-Formation präsentiert ein Programm, zugeschnitten auf die Stadt der Aufführung. Dieses Mal werden geistliche Madrigale von Johann Hermann Schein, Motetten aus Heinrich Schütz sowie zwei Motetten von Johann Sebastian Bach aufgeführt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-04-28

classica.us.title: Bach - Goldberg-Variationen, BWV 988
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti spielt 2015 im Theater Carlo Felice in Genua Bachs Goldberg-Variationen, BWV 988. Das Werk ist nach dem Cembalisten Johann Gottlieb Goldberg benannt, der möglicherweise der erste Interpret des Werkes war. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2014-01-15

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino bei einer Aufführung von Gustav Mahlers Symphonie Nr. 9 in D-Dur. Diese Symphonie wurde in den Jahren 1908-1909 geschrieben und war die letzte, die Mahler vollendete. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-23

classica.us.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchestra und den Chor in einem Konzert mit Werken von Richard Strauss, Metamorphosen, und Mozarts Requiem. Die Solisten sind Siobhan Stagg, Avery Amereau, Ben Bliss und Anthony Robin Schneider. Aufgenommen wurde dies in der Severance Hall, Cleveland im März 2023. (Special, Music) - 2023-01-01

classica.us.title: The Babylon Hotel
classica.us.description: Das Dänische Symphonieorchester, die Dänische Radio Big Band und Gäste führen im Konzert durch Musik aus Der große Gatsby, Babylon, Burlesque, Haus der Träume und Babylon Berlin sowie den Opern Porgy und Bess und Mahagonny. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-02-01

classica.us.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda (1975) spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation des technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. Er ist besonders für seine Interpretationen einiger kürzlich entdeckter Werke von Mendelssohn und seine 9-teilige CD-Serie über Klavierwerke des Komponisten bekannt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-12-15

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 5 in c-Moll, op. 67
classica.us.description: In der Oper von Dijon, wo das Ensemble residiert, interpretieren die Mitglieder von Les Dissonances die Symphonie Nr. 5 in C-Dur, Opus 67, von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Originalität dieser Sinfonie liegt im anfänglichen Vier-Noten-Motiv. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2015-08-24

classica.us.title: Europakonzert 2013 aus Prag
classica.us.description: Ralph Vaughan Williams: "Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis" - Antonín Dvořák: Biblische Lieder op. 99 - Ludwig van Beethoven: Symphonie Nr. 6 F-Dur op. 68 "Pastorale". Magdalena Kožená (Mezzosopran), Berliner Philharmoniker, Leitung: Simon Rattle. Die Europakonzerte der Berliner Philharmoniker sind ein Beitrag des renommierten Orchesters zur europäischen Vereinigung. Sie finden jedes Jahr am 1. Mai an einem anderen Austragungsort statt. (Special, Music) - 2014-12-03

classica.us.title: Eine Hommage an Wien
classica.us.description: Am 9. März 2011 zollten die Wiener Philharmoniker ihrer Heimatstadt mit einem Walzer-Konzert Tribut. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2021-08-20

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 6 in F-Dur, op. 68

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Sinfonie Nr. 3 in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Gianandrea Noseda leitet das Orchester des Teatro alla Scala in Mailand. Auf dem Spielprogramm stehen Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphonie Nr. 3 Es-Dur op. 55. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2014-01-15

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa's Office

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Caravan Friends

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Daddy Loses His Glasses
